about_the_game:
The Elementalist Typing is a tactical typing RPG featuring elemental magic.  Hone your typing skills and sharpen your wits to defeat your enemies!  Collect treasures to upgrade your wizard and turn your boring home into a fabulous wizards den!

Featuring colorful hand-drawn pixel graphics and parallax scrolling 2D settings.  Adventure through beautiful and spooky environments while fighting a host of varied enemies.

Battles depend on your typing skill and wits.  Successfully typing the target text will launch a basic attack from your currently selected element and gain you a bit of mana.  Use your mana wisely to cast more powerful spells that can make all the difference when facing a tough boss.

A custom mad-lib engine generates endless typing variety with periodically hilarious results (grammar not strictly guaranteed).

Select a challenge that is right for you -- practice typing letters, words, or sentences of increasing length.  The Elementalist Typing is intended to be family friendly fun for typists of all ages -- numerous options allow you to customize the typing practice to fit any skill level.

Play through 48 levels of challenge featuring 12 bosses!  Or challenge yourself to see how far you can go in one of 8 endless runs that slowly ramp up the difficulty to really test your skills!

Make typing practice fun with The Elementalist Typing!
